info.description: statvista basketball and baseball data backend. Database-backed endpoints read from Supabase (silver / gold schemas) and make no NBA or Odds API calls. The exceptions are /api/wnba/scoreboard/today, /api/mlb/scoreboard/today, /api/mlb/scoreboard, /api/mlb/odds/today, /api/wnba/leaders, /api/wnba/player/{player_id}, /api/wnba/standings, /api/wnba/futures, /api/wnba/odds/today, /api/wnba/props/today, WNBA game detail routes, /api/mlb/games/{game_pk}, /api/mlb/lineups, and /api/mlb/futures, which call ESPN, stats.wnba.com, MLB Stats API, RotoWire, or SharpAPI for live league data.
info.title: statvista API
